env
Change Log
==========

Security and reliability
------------------------
- Escape JSON, CSV, and table output, including spreadsheet formula prefixes
  and control characters that could inject rows or columns.
- Limit child-process handle inheritance to standard input, output, and error.
- Resolve executable paths using the modified environment and working
  directory without implicit current-directory executable lookup.
- Validate child environment entries, enforce the Windows environment-block
  size limit, and use the required double-NUL terminator for empty blocks.
- Check environment loading, output writes, pipe status, process waits, and
  child exit-code retrieval; report failures with non-zero status.
- Reject missing option arguments, malformed split strings, conflicting
  output modes, and incompatible listing options.
- Avoid printing assigned environment values in verbose diagnostics.

Modularization and command line
-------------------------------
- Replace included implementation fragments with separately compiled
  environment, argument, output, process, and application modules.
- Use concise, purpose-specific module filenames and keep env.cpp as the entry
  point.
- Preserve options parsed before -S expansion and validate quoting and escapes.

Build and documentation
-----------------------
- Update PowerShell, batch, and Windows shell builds to compile all modules.
- Create bin when needed and install env.exe there by default; keep noinstall
  as an explicit opt-out.
- Make the POSIX shell build report that this Windows API utility requires a
  Windows build environment.
- Refresh the built-in help and version information to match supported behavior.
